title: Post: “it’s from the drone company next door”

fields.avatarBrief: generic middle-aged person with neutral expression, wearing a casual jacket
fields.text: Drone buzzing the crowd at the Harwick Fair — it’s from the drone company next door, saw it go up from behind their hangar!! @HarwickPD

instructorNote: Watch for a statement that is true without guessing about the operator.

snapshot.title: Drone Sighting Post — Harwick Fairgrounds Crowd

fields.avatarBrief: generic middle-aged person with neutral expression, wearing a casual jacket
fields.text: Just saw a drone with a red light over the fairgrounds crowd. It’s not one of the Group’s drones, right? They’re not allowed to fly today. But why is it over 6,000 people? #HarwickFairgrounds #DroneOverCrowd
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo taken from ground level, showing a small drone with a red light visible in midair above a crowd, blurred background of tents and people
fields.attachedImageAlt: Drone with red light circling above a large crowd at an outdoor fair

snapshot.instructorNote: This post introduces public pressure and misinformation. The PIO must follow policy and forward to Corporate Communications and the ASO. Watch for whether the ASO logs it as a hazard.
